```{r Fig1b site distribution}
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "long_term_ec_sites.csv"))
a_YY_all <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "a_YY_carbon_flux_all.csv"))

sites_long <- sites_long %>% left_join(a_YY_all %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% summarise(nyear = sum(!is.na(NEE_VUT_REF)), .groups = "drop"), by = "site_ID")

tmp <- a_YY_all %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% summarise(n_DT = sum(!is.na(GPP_DT_VUT_REF)), n_NT = sum(!is.na(GPP_NT_VUT_REF)))
tmp$site_ID[tmp$n_DT == 0]      # "CH-Aws" "DE-RuW" "JP-Tak" "JP-Yms" "US-Aud" "US-Esm" "US-Ho1" "US-ICt" "US-MtB" "US-PFa"
tmp$site_ID[tmp$n_NT == 0]      # "AU-Cow" "AU-Rob" "ES-LJu"


# get distribution of data-duration
ggplot(data=sites_long, aes(x=nyear)) +
  geom_histogram()


# get site_years; it will be good to see this. where are these data?
p2 <- a_YY_all %>% group_by(TIMESTAMP) %>% summarise(nSites=n()) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=TIMESTAMP, y=nSites)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", alpha=0.5) +
#  geom_line() +
  labs(x='Year', y='Site-years') +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 7),   
        axis.title = element_text(size = 7),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA))
p2
inset_grob_siteyears <- ggplotGrob(p2)


# number of sites for each climate category
sites_long %>% group_by(category) %>% summarise(nSites=n())
# 
tmp <- a_YY_all %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% summarise(nYears=n())
long_term_sites <- tmp$site_ID[tmp$nYears >= 18]
#
# adding one column to indicate if a site has abrupt change
sites_long_mutate <- sites_long %>% mutate(long_term = site_ID %in% long_term_sites) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(category=='wet' ~ "Ecosystems in wet-warm climate",
                           category=='dry' ~ "Ecosystems in dry climate",
                           IGBP %in% c("ENF") & category=='cold' ~ "ENF in wet-cold climate",
                           IGBP %in% c("DBF", "MF", "DNF") & category=='cold' ~ "DBF+DNF+MF in wet-cold climate",
                           !IGBP %in% c("ENF", "EBF","DBF", "MF", "DNF") & category=='cold' ~ "Non-forest in wet-cold climate")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels=c("Ecosystems in dry climate", "Ecosystems in wet-warm climate",
                                        "ENF in wet-cold climate", "DBF+DNF+MF in wet-cold climate",
                                        "Non-forest in wet-cold climate"))) %>%
  mutate(point_size = ifelse(long_term, "≥ two decades", "< two decades"))

###############################################
# make a plot for locations of these sites
# in this figure, I should have long-term and non-long sites
# how many sites are observed each year
mundi <- terra::vect(rnaturalearthdata::coastline110)
mundi <- terra::crop(mundi,ext(c(-180,180,-60,90)))
#
#
p1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_spatvector(data = mundi, linewidth = .2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey") + 
  geom_point(data=sites_long_mutate, aes(x=Long, y=Lat, fill=group, size = point_size), shape = 21, stroke = 0.5, color='black') +
  scale_size_manual(values=c("≥ two decades"=2, "< two decades"=1.5)) +  # use raw size values without legend scaling  
  # scale_fill_manual(values=c('Ecosystems in wet-warm climate' = "blue", 'Ecosystems in dry climate' = "#E4003A", 
  #                            'ENF and EBF in wet-cold climate' = "#234e22", "DBF and MF in wet-cold climate" = "#4eae49",
  #                            "Non-forest in wet-cold climate" = '#A0C878')) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('Ecosystems in wet-warm climate' = "#facecf", 'Ecosystems in dry climate' = "#f3e089",
                             'ENF in wet-cold climate' = "#2bb673", "DBF+DNF+MF in wet-cold climate" = "#8dc63f",
                             "Non-forest in wet-cold climate" = '#a2e0f6')) +   # #febfbd #fcfe75 #234e22; #4eae49
  labs(x='Longitude', y='Latitude', fill=NULL, size='Data duration') +  #, tag = 'b'
  coord_sf(expand=FALSE, xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-60, 80)) + 
  guides(size = "none") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black"),
        ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.15, 0.17),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),

    legend.key.width  = unit(0.5, "cm"),

    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA)
  )

p1_2 <- p1 +
```

```{r Fig 1a decadal trends of terrestrial carbon sinks}
#
carbon_sink <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'global-carbon-budget-2025-terrestrial-sink-gcb.csv'), skip = 35)
names(carbon_sink)[1:2] <- c("year", "c_sink")
# 
window_size = 15
carbon_sink_trend <- data.frame(year_mid = integer(), trend = double(), lower = double(), upper = double())
# 
year_start <- min(carbon_sink$year) 
year_end <- max(carbon_sink$year)
nwindow = max(year_end - year_start + 1 - window_size + 1, 1)
#
for (iwindow in 1:nwindow) {
  years_window <- (year_start + iwindow - 1):(year_start + iwindow + window_size - 2)
  carbon_sink_window <- carbon_sink %>% filter(year %in% years_window)
  carbon_sink_trend[iwindow, "year_mid"] <- median(years_window)
  carbon_sink_trend[iwindow, "trend"] <- sens.slope(carbon_sink_window$c_sink)$estimate
  carbon_sink_trend[iwindow, "lower"] <- sens.slope(carbon_sink_window$c_sink)$conf.int[1]
  carbon_sink_trend[iwindow, "upper"] <- sens.slope(carbon_sink_window$c_sink)$conf.int[2]
}
#
p_dynamics <- ggplot(data=carbon_sink) +
  geom_point(aes(x=year, y=c_sink), col='black', size=0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x=year, y=c_sink), col='black', size=0.35) +
  # geom_line(aes(x=year_trend, y=c_sink_trend)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x=year, y=c_sink), method = "lm", se = F, col = "darkgrey", size = 0.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1960, 2024), breaks = seq(1960, 2024, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4), breaks = seq(0, 4, 1)) +
  labs(x='Year', y=expression("C sink (Pg C yr"^{-1}~")"), tag='a',
       title = "Long-term increase in the land carbon sink") +
  # expression(atop("Land C sink ", "(Pg C yr"^{-1}~")"))
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11), 
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 7.5,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.0)
  )  
p_dynamics
#
p_trend <- carbon_sink_trend %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = year_mid, y = trend)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.35, color = "#6F83B5") + # grey35
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, color = "#3C5488") +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, color = "#3C5488") + 
  labs(x = "Midpoint year of each moving window", 
       y = expression("Trend (Pg C yr"^{-2}~")"), tag = "b",
       title = "15-year moving-window trend in the land carbon sink") +
  # expression(atop("Decadal trend of", "C sink (Pg C yr"^{-2}~")"))
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1960, 2024), breaks = seq(1960, 2024, by = 10)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 7.5,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.0)
  )
p_trend
#
p1_2 <- plot_grid(p_dynamics, p_trend, align = "hv", nrow = 2, ncol = 1)
p1_2

ggsave(plot = p1_2, file.path(dir_fig, 'Fig1a_hypothesis_background.png'), width = 4.5, height = 3, units = "in", bg = "transparent")
```

```{r Fig2 overall NEE GPP ER trend and trend relationships}
#
NEEdynamic <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "NEE_mean_overall_dynamics.csv"))
#
NEEdynamic <- NEEdynamic %>% filter(!is.na(ci_lower) & n_sites >= 12) %>% 
  mutate(bootstrap_median = -bootstrap_median, ci_upper_tmp = -ci_lower, ci_lower = -ci_upper, ci_upper = ci_upper_tmp) %>%
  mutate(climate_veg = factor(climate_veg, levels = c("cold_evergreen_forest", "cold_deciduous_forest", "cold_non_forest", "wet-warm", "dry")))
facet_labs <- c(
  "cold_evergreen_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nENF",
  "cold_deciduous_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nDBF+DNF+MF",
  "cold_non_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nnon-forest",
  "wet-warm" = "Wet-warm climate:\nall ecosystems",
  "dry" = "Dry climate:\nall ecosystems" )

#-----first row of figures
ribbon_NEEdynamic <- NEEdynamic %>%
  arrange(climate_veg, year) %>%
  group_by(climate_veg) %>%
  mutate(
    year_next = lead(year),
    ci_lower_next = lead(ci_lower),
    ci_upper_next = lead(ci_upper),
    n_sites_seg = (n_sites + lead(n_sites)) / 2,
    seg_id = row_number()
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(year_next)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  reframe(
    climate_veg = climate_veg,
    seg_id = seg_id,
    n_sites_seg = n_sites_seg,
    year = c(year, year_next, year_next, year),
    y = c(ci_lower, ci_lower_next, ci_upper_next, ci_upper)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_NEE <- ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(
    data = ribbon_NEEdynamic,
    aes(x = year, y = y,
        climate_veg = interaction(climate_veg, seg_id),
        fill = n_sites_seg), alpha = 0.85, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = NEEdynamic, aes(x = year, y = bootstrap_median), linewidth = 0.1, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = NEEdynamic, aes(x = year, y = bootstrap_median), color = "black", size = 1.1) +
  geom_smooth(data = NEEdynamic, aes(x = year, y = bootstrap_median), method = "loess", 
              span = 0.75, se = F, linewidth = 0.5, color = "#2C7BB6") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.35) +
  facet_wrap(~ climate_veg, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(climate_veg = facet_labs)) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "grey90",
    high = "grey35",
    name = "Number of ecosystems", 
    # guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = expression(atop("Mean annual NEP", "(g C m"^{-2} ~ "yr"^{-1} * ")")), tag = "a") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2000, 2025), breaks = seq(2000, 2025, by = 10)) + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 0.9, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.72), 
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"), 
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
p_NEE

# site-level GPP trend and ER trend relationships

trend_driver <- read.csv("/Users/junnawang/YaleLab/manuscript2/figures/SI_data/Carbon_flux_trend_moving_window.csv")
#--------------------------------------
############ Make a panel about GPP and ER trend relationships############################################################## 
trend_driver_cold_forest <- trend_driver %>% filter(category == 'cold') %>%
  filter (IGBP %in% c("DBF", "ENF", "MF", "DNF", "EBF")) %>%
  mutate(period = ifelse(year_mid >= 2013, 'Midpoint year 2013 onward', 'Midpoint year before 2013')) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c('Midpoint year before 2013', 'Midpoint year 2013 onward')))

trend_driver_cold_forest_1site <- trend_driver_cold_forest %>% group_by(site_ID, period, method) %>% 
  summarise(GPP_at_mean = mean(GPP_at, na.rm = T), ER_at_mean = mean(ER_at, na.rm = T))

summary(lm(data = trend_driver_cold_forest_1site %>% filter(method == "DT" & period == "Midpoint year before 2013"), ER_at_mean ~ GPP_at_mean + 0))
```

```{r quantify GPP and ER trend relations }
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))
##------------------------------------------------------------------------------
source(file.path("scripts2026", "00_functions.R"))
a_YY_Cflux <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "a_YY_carbon_flux_all.csv"))
#
Cflux_trend <- data.frame(site_ID = character(), 
                          GPP_at_DT = double(), ER_at_DT = double(), 
                          GPP_at_NT = double(), ER_at_NT = double(),
                          DT_at_error = double(), NT_at_error = double(),
                          period = character())
#
id = 1
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  a_YY_Cflux_site <- a_YY_Cflux %>% filter(site_ID == sites_long$site_ID[i])
  #
  years <- a_YY_Cflux_site$TIMESTAMP[!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site$NEE_VUT_REF)]
  year_start <- min(years) 
  year_end <- max(years)
  #
  if (length(years) >= 20) {
    # before 2013, and after 2013
    Cflux_trend[id, 1] <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
    Cflux_trend$period[id] <- "before"
    a_YY_Cflux_site_period <- a_YY_Cflux_site %>% filter( TIMESTAMP %in% year_start:(year_start+14) )
    if ( sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)) >= 9 ) {
      Cflux_trend$GPP_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$ER_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$DT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }
    #
    if ( sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)) >= 9 ) {
      Cflux_trend$GPP_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$ER_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$NT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }
    Cflux_trend$NEE_at[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    id = id + 1
    
    
    #
    Cflux_trend[id, 1] <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
    Cflux_trend$period[id] <- "after"
    a_YY_Cflux_site_period <- a_YY_Cflux_site %>% filter( TIMESTAMP %in% (year_end-14):(year_end) )
    #
    if ( sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)) >= 9 ) {
      Cflux_trend$GPP_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$ER_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$DT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }
    #
    if ( sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)) >= 9 ) {
      Cflux_trend$GPP_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$ER_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$NT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }
    Cflux_trend$NEE_at[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    id = id + 1
  } else {
    #
    Cflux_trend[id, 1] <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
    #
    if (median(years) >= 2013) {
      Cflux_trend$period[id] <- "after"
      a_YY_Cflux_site_period <- a_YY_Cflux_site %>% filter( TIMESTAMP %in% (year_end-14):(year_end) )
    } else {
      Cflux_trend$period[id] <- "before"
      a_YY_Cflux_site_period <- a_YY_Cflux_site %>% filter( TIMESTAMP %in% year_start:(year_start+14) )
    }
    #
    
    if ( sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)) >= 9 ) {
      Cflux_trend$GPP_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$ER_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$DT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }
    #
    if ( sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)) >= 9 ) {
      Cflux_trend$GPP_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$ER_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend$NT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }
    Cflux_trend$NEE_at[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    id = id + 1
  }
}

##-------------Alternative methods moving windows, this is used-----------------
##------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Cflux_trend_moving <- data.frame(
  site_ID = character(), year_start = integer(), year_end = integer(), year_mid = numeric(),
  GPP_at_DT = double(), ER_at_DT = double(), GPP_at_NT = double(), ER_at_NT = double(),
  DT_at_error = double(), NT_at_error = double(), NEE_at = double()
)

id <- 1
window_size <- 15

for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  a_YY_Cflux_site <- a_YY_Cflux %>%
    filter(site_ID == sites_long$site_ID[i])

  years <- a_YY_Cflux_site$TIMESTAMP[!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site$NEE_VUT_REF)]
  if (length(years) == 0) next

  year_start <- min(years)
  year_end <- max(years)

  if (length(unique(years)) < window_size) {
    window_starts <- year_start
    window_ends <- year_end
  } else {
    window_starts <- year_start:(year_end - window_size + 1)
    window_ends <- window_starts + window_size - 1
  }

  for (j in seq_along(window_starts)) {
    start_year <- window_starts[j]
    end_year <- window_ends[j]

    a_YY_Cflux_site_period <- a_YY_Cflux_site %>%
      filter(TIMESTAMP %in% start_year:end_year)

    Cflux_trend_moving[id, c("site_ID", "year_start", "year_end", "year_mid")] <-
      list(sites_long$site_ID[i], start_year, end_year, mean(c(start_year, end_year)))

    if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)) >= 9) {
      Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_DT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend_moving$DT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_DT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }

    if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)) >= 9) {
      Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_NT[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF)
      Cflux_trend_moving$NT_at_error[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$RECO_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$GPP_NT_VUT_REF - a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }

    if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)) >= 9) {
      Cflux_trend_moving$NEE_at[id] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_Cflux_site_period$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_Cflux_site_period$NEE_VUT_REF)
    }

    id <- id + 1
  }
}

# If one site has only one method, fill the other method using the available method
Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_DT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_DT)] <-
  Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_NT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_DT)]

Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_DT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_DT)] <-
  Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_NT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_DT)]

Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_NT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_NT)] <-
  Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_DT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$GPP_at_NT)]

Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_NT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_NT)] <-
  Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_DT[is.na(Cflux_trend_moving$ER_at_NT)]
```

```{r FigS GPP ER trend relationships}
############ Make a panel about GPP and ER trend relationships############################################################## 

trend_driver_1site <- trend_driver %>% 
  mutate(period = ifelse(year_mid >= 2013, 'Midpoint year 2013 onward', 'Midpoint year before 2013')) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c('Midpoint year before 2013', 'Midpoint year 2013 onward'))) %>%
  mutate(climate_veg = case_when( category == "cold" & IGBP %in% c("ENF", "EBF", "DBF", "DNF", "MF") ~ "cold_forest", 
                                  category == "cold" & !IGBP %in% c("ENF", "EBF", "DBF", "DNF", "MF") ~ "cold_non_forest",
                                  category == "dry" ~ "dry", 
                                  category == "wet" ~ "wet-warm")) %>%
  mutate(climate_veg = factor(climate_veg, levels = c("cold_forest", "cold_non_forest", "wet-warm", "dry"))) %>%
  mutate(method = ifelse(method == "DT", "Daytime partition", "Nighttime partition")) %>%
  group_by(site_ID, period, method, climate_veg) %>% 
  summarise(GPP_at_mean = mean(GPP_at, na.rm = T), ER_at_mean = mean(ER_at, na.rm = T)) %>%
  filter(site_ID != "ZA-Kru")


facet_labs <- c(
  "cold_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\n forest ecosystems",
  "cold_non_forest" = "Wet-cold climate:\nnon-forest ecosystems",
  "wet-warm" = "Wet-warm climate:\nall ecosystems",
  "dry" = "Dry climate:\nall ecosystems" )

# adding equations
library(ggpmisc)
p_GPP_ER_partition <- ggplot(data = trend_driver_1site, aes(x = GPP_at_mean, y = ER_at_mean, col = period)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = "y ~ x + 0") + 
  # stat_poly_eq(
  #   aes(label = paste(after_stat(eq.label), after_stat(p.value.label), sep = "~~~")),

  # ) +  
  labs(x = expression("GPP trend (g C m"^{-2} ~ "yr"^{-2} * ")"), 
       y = expression("ER trend (g C m"^{-2} ~ "yr"^{-2} * ")"),
       col = "Moving window", 
       tag = "c") + 
  # geom_text(
  #   data = label_df,
  #   aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, color = period),
  #   parse = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE, 
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 4) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # lims(y = c(-80, 130)) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(method),
    cols = vars(climate_veg),
    labeller = labeller(climate_veg = facet_labs)

  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.35, 0.5),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),

        strip.text = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 0.9, face = "bold"))
```

```{r Fig3 plot total effect size of drivers of NEE trend}
# we only need statistically significant variables. 
total_es <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'effect_total_NEE_trend_driver.csv'))

# since I am working on NEP, change the sign of effect size
total_es <- total_es %>% mutate(estimate = -estimate, ci_lower_2.5_tmp = - ci_upper_97.5, ci_upper_97.5 = - ci_lower_2.5, ci_lower_2.5 = ci_lower_2.5_tmp) %>%
  mutate(ci_lower_5_tmp = - ci_upper_95, ci_upper_95 = - ci_lower_5, ci_lower_5 = ci_lower_5_tmp) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ci_lower_2.5_tmp, ci_lower_5_tmp))

total_es <- total_es %>% mutate(sig95 = !between(rep(0.0, nrow(total_es)), ci_lower_2.5, ci_upper_97.5)) %>% 
  mutate(sig90 = !between(rep(0.0, nrow(total_es)), ci_lower_5, ci_upper_95)) %>% 
  filter(!exposure %in% c("SW_ngs_t",  "P_ngs_at"))

# variables in wet warm climate should be growing season

total_es$exposure[total_es$exposure=='P_at'] <- 'P_gs_at'

total_es$exposure[total_es$exposure=='LE_gs_at'] <- 'ET_gs_at'
```

```{r FigS changes in future climate trends}
    group_name <- "Wet-cold climate: DBF+DNF+MF"
  } else if (groups$koppen_geiger_0p00833333[i] == 'cold_ENF') {
    group_name <- "Wet-cold climate: ENF"
  } else if (groups$koppen_geiger_0p00833333[i] == 'cold_nonforest') {
    group_name <- "Wet-cold climate: non-forests"
  } else if (groups$koppen_geiger_0p00833333[i] == 'dry') {
    group_name <- "Dry climate: all ecosystems"
  } else if (groups$koppen_geiger_0p00833333[i] == 'wet') {
    group_name <- "Wet-warm climate: all ecosystems"
  }
  #
  if (groups$koppen_geiger_0p00833333[i] == 'cold_DBF') {
    df_plot <- rbind(df_plot, data.frame(value = terra::values(ta_ngs_at_change)[cells], var = "Air Temperature", group = group_name))
  } else {
    df_plot <- rbind(df_plot, data.frame(value = terra::values(ta_gs_at_change)[cells], var = "Air Temperature", group = group_name))
  }
  df_plot <- rbind(df_plot, data.frame(value = terra::values(co2_change)[cells], var = "Atmospheric CO2", group = group_name))
  if (groups$koppen_geiger_0p00833333[i] == 'wet') { 
    df_plot <- rbind(df_plot, data.frame(value = terra::values(le_gs_at_change)[cells], var = "Evapotranspiration", group = group_name))
```

```{r FigS partial plot of key drivers of NEE trend based on random forests }
# fun1
make_pd_plot <- function(df, cv, var, xlab = var, xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL,
                         title_label = cv, tag_label = tag, effect_df = NULL,
                         label_x = Inf, label_y = Inf) {
  d <- df %>% filter(climate_veg == cv, variable == var) 
  
  if (!is.null(xlim)) {
    d <- d %>% filter(between(x_numeric, xlim[1], xlim[2]))
  }

  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = paste(cv, var, "missing", sep = "\n")) +
        theme_void()
    )
  }

  label <- NULL
  if (!is.null(effect_df)) {
    effect_size <- effect_df %>%
      filter(climate_veg == cv, exposure == var) %>%
      pull(estimate)

    if (length(effect_size) > 0 && !is.na(effect_size[1])) {
      label <- paste0("'LMM effect size: ' * bold('", sprintf("%.2f", effect_size[1]), "')")
    }
  }

  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = x_numeric, y = yhat)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = title_label, tag = tag_label, 
      x = xlab,
      y = expression("NEP trend (g C m"^{-2} ~ "yr"^{-2} ~ ")")
    )

  if (!is.null(xlim) || !is.null(ylim)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim)
  }

  if (!is.null(label)) {
    p <- p +
      annotate("text", x = label_x, y = label_y, label = label,
               parse = TRUE, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 4)
  }

  p
}

library(grid)

row_title <- function(label) {
  wrap_elements(
    grid::textGrob(
      label,
      x = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
}

row1_body <- wrap_plots(row1, ncol = 4)
row2_body <- wrap_plots(row2, ncol = 4)
row3_body <- wrap_plots(row3, ncol = 4)
row4_body <- wrap_plots(c(row4, list(plot_spacer(), plot_spacer(), plot_spacer())), ncol = 4)

p_final <-
  row_title("Direct effect of atmosphere CO2 concentration") / row1_body /
  row_title("Direct effect of air temperature trend") / row2_body /
  row_title("Direct effect of water availability trend") / row3_body /
  row_title("Direct effect of Disturbance trend") / row4_body +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.08, 1, 0.08, 1, 0.08, 1, 0.08, 1))
p_final

dir_fig <- '/Users/junnawang/YaleLab/manuscript2/figures'
ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, "FigS_RF_partial_plots.png"), plot = p_final, width = 14, height = 16, dpi = 300)
```

```{r FigS driver~NEE trend relationships from observations}
trend_driver <- read.csv(file.path("data2026", "potential_trend_driver.csv"))
trend_driver$NEE_at <- -trend_driver$NEE_at
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data2026', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))

if (!'category' %in% names(trend_driver)) {
  trend_driver <- trend_driver %>% left_join(sites_long[, c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition", "source")], by = "site_ID")
}

data_cold_evergreen_forest <- trend_driver %>% filter(IGBP %in% c('ENF', 'EBF') & category == "cold")
#
p1 <- data_cold_evergreen_forest %>% ggplot(aes(x=CO2, y = NEE_at, col = site_ID)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE) +
  theme_classic() + 
  labs(x = expression(CO[2] ~ "concentration (ppm)"), 
       y = expression("NEP trend (g C m"^{-2} ~ "yr"^{-2} ~ ")"), title = "Wet-cold climate: ENF", tag = 'a') +
  guides(col = guide_legend(ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE))
p1
```
